title: 37.8 A 13.5µW 35-Keyword End-to-End Keyword Spotting System Featuring Personalized On-Chip Training in 28nm CMOS
problem: Existing keyword spotting systems recognize only up to 10 keywords with low accuracy for accented speakers, and lack user-specific trainability, limiting personalization for diverse speech patterns and larger vocabularies.
motivation: Consumer devices require personalized KWS supporting 35+ keywords with high accuracy across diverse accents while minimizing power consumption during both inference and training.
method: The system employs a compact CNN with on-chip training capability, featuring a sine-based convolution with approximate logarithm function as a low-complexity feature extractor. Training occurs on-chip to adapt to individual users, enabling personalization without external servers while maintaining power efficiency through compact architecture and quantized operations.
key_novelty: On-chip personalized training with sine-based approximate logarithm convolution enabling low-power 35-keyword recognition across accents.
contributions: 35-keyword KWS system supporting 9 different accent profiles
Sine-based convolution with approximate logarithm for low-complexity feature extraction
primary_theme: Low-power personalized multi-keyword speech spotting with on-chip training
